source: Live poe.ninja PoE2 economy (Runes of Aldur), in exalt-equivalents: currency and desecration bones from the API, essences priced individually, omens hand-transcribed from the Omens page (no API serves them) — see tools/refresh/prices.mjs.
omenQuotesSource: https://poe.ninja/poe2/economy/runesofaldur/omens — transcribed by hand; poe.ninja's economy API has no `type` value that serves omens (Currency/Essences/Fragments/Runes do), and the web page is client-rendered, so this is the only route.
caveat: All prices are live market data, except 51 essence variants nobody is currently trading — those are inferred from the same essence's other levels.
